card.name: Linking word before a diagnostic test
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as via, using, by or an opening bracket that come right after a specimen or biomarker and introduce the test or method used, mostly in oncology indication statements.

modes.label: Test-method link
modes.description: Via, using or by after a biomarker or plasma specimen, introducing an authorized test or method.
